code.INVALID_URL: The URL was not recognized as a supported Douyin or TikTok link.
code.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: That content type is not supported yet.
code.INVALID_PARAM: One or more request parameters are invalid.
code.FORBIDDEN_SCOPE: This key or account lacks the scope required by this endpoint.
code.NOT_FOUND: The requested resource does not exist.
code.CONTENT_PRIVATE: This content is private or has been removed by its author.
code.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Back off and try again shortly.
code.IDENTITY_POOL_EXHAUSTED: No identity is available right now; the pool is recovering.
code.ENDPOINT_CIRCUIT_OPEN: This endpoint is paused after repeated failures.
code.UPSTREAM_RISK_CONTROL: The platform flagged the request as automated traffic.
code.UPSTREAM_CHANGED: The platform response no longer matches the expected structure.
code.SIGNING_FAILED: Request signing failed; the signing algorithm may be out of date.
code.TASK_NOT_FOUND: No task exists with that id, or its result has already expired.
code.SETUP_ALREADY_DONE: Setup has already been completed on this instance.
code.SETUP_TOKEN_INVALID: The setup token is invalid or has expired.

hint.INVALID_URL: Check the link and paste it again. Retrying will not help.
hint.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: Nothing to retry here; this type is not implemented.
hint.INVALID_PARAM: Correct the highlighted fields and submit again.
hint.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session may have expired. Sign in and retry.
hint.FORBIDDEN_SCOPE: Grant the required scope, or use a key that already has it.
hint.NOT_FOUND: The content is gone. This is not a system fault.
hint.CONTENT_PRIVATE: Only the author can make this content public again.
hint.RATE_LIMITED: Wait for the window to reset, then retry.
hint.IDENTITY_POOL_EXHAUSTED: Check the identity pool: mint more, or wait for cooldowns to end.
hint.ENDPOINT_CIRCUIT_OPEN: Wait for the circuit to reopen, or use another endpoint.
hint.UPSTREAM_RISK_CONTROL: The identity was cooled down. Retry later or add proxies.
hint.UPSTREAM_CHANGED: This is a bug in dtk, not in your deployment. Please report it with the request id.
hint.SIGNING_FAILED: Check browser-rpc reachability on the System page, then retry.
hint.SETUP_TOKEN_INVALID: Restart the api container to print a fresh token in the logs.
hint.INTERNAL: Report the issue with the request id and check the server logs.
hint.NOT_CONFIGURED: This instance does not have that component set up. It is a deployment setting, not a temporary failure, so retrying will not help.

generic.network: Cannot reach the API. Check that the service is running and reachable.
generic.timeout: The request timed out before the server replied.
generic.taskTimeout: The task is still running. It will finish in the background.
generic.malformed: The API returned a response the console could not read.

boundary.title: This page crashed
boundary.description: The console hit an unexpected error while rendering. Reloading usually clears it.

label.reportHint: Include the request id when reporting this issue.

loadFailed.title: Could not load this data
loadFailed.description: The request failed. Retry, or check the System page for component health.
